title: Perplexity Sonar joins the text models
summary:
Perplexity Sonar models and public model discovery landed alongside Pollen estimates, streaming repairs, and a website migration still needing a build fix.

Added `perplexity-fast` and `perplexity-reasoning`, both with tool support. Response validation now accepts the empty finish reason Perplexity can return in regular and streaming completions.

Added a public text-model list endpoint and browser-ready examples in the API docs. The website was switched toward Enter’s image, text, and model endpoints, with clearer image-generation errors and a restored full-color image watermark. A follow-up configuration edit introduced duplicate declarations that block the frontend build, so the website migration should not be treated as working end to end.

Enter gained text and image pricing tables showing model-specific rates and estimated output per Pollen. The service registry also dropped tier requirements and tier-based queue limits; the changes do not establish a new price or guarantee access to a particular model.

highlights.title: Perplexity Sonar arrives
highlights.text: Use `perplexity-fast` for conversational text and tool calls. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=perplexity-fast).

highlights.title: Sonar with reasoning
highlights.text: Try `perplexity-reasoning` for reasoning-capable conversations with tool support. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=perplexity-reasoning).

highlights.title: Public text model discovery
highlights.text: Fetch the text-model list without authentication from `GET /api/generate/text/models`. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
